items.title: BNY Holds $63 Trillion for Clients and Will Now Custody XRP. What If 0.1% of That Went Into XRP?
items.summary: BNY now custodies XRP for a bank holding $63 trillion in client assets, and XRP holders are already doing the math on what even a sliver of that figure could mean for the price. The case for optimism has a problem hiding in plain sight.
